real_name: Ibrahim Athar (real name kept in film)
real_life_notes: Brother of Masood Azhar (JeM founder). Along with his brother Abdul Rauf Azhar and brother-in-law Yusuf Azhar, was involved in planning the IC-814 hijacking. The Athar-Azhar family forms the operational core of JeM. Ibrahim Athar coordinated from Pakistan during the hijacking. UN-designated terrorist.
film_role: Film 1 opening — Ibrahim Athar is part of the IC-814 hijack planning network. His presence in the Kandahar sequence connects the 1999 event to the broader JeM-ISI nexus that Hamza is later deployed to dismantle.
objective: Continue JeM operations; maintain ISI patronage; avenge Masood Azhar's original imprisonment
